reasoning_content: I have the PR metadata and body. Now let me get the list of files changed and commits to get direct file links and verify details.

action.command:
curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/OpenHands/OpenHands/pulls/16860/files?per_page=100" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for f in d:
    print(f['status'], f['filename'], '+'+str(f['additions']), '-'+str(f['deletions']))
"

tool_call.name: terminal
